scenarios.title: Toggle Application Theme using Dark Mode Switch
scenarios.business_objective: Enable users to toggle the visual interface between light and dark themes to improve user experience and accessibility.
preconditions: The user is on an active application page containing the dark mode toggle switch.
steps: User clicks the dark mode switch element (LOC-0001).
scenarios.expected_result: The visual theme of the application toggles to dark mode.

scenarios.title: Open Demo Project
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to open and inspect a pre-configured demo project.
preconditions: The user is navigating the application interface where project choices are present.
steps: User clicks the option to open the demo project (LOC-0002).
scenarios.expected_result: The application opens and loads the demo project.

scenarios.title: Access BRD Compliance Criterion Level View
scenarios.business_objective: Provide functionality to access and review compliance details at the BRD criterion level.
preconditions: The user is viewing the compliance navigation controls.
steps: User clicks the element to access the BRD compliance criterion level (LOC-0003).
scenarios.expected_result: The application navigates to the BRD compliance criterion level view.

scenarios.title: Create a New Project
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to initiate the creation of a new project.
preconditions: The user is on a page with project management controls available.
steps: User clicks the control to create a new project (LOC-0004).
scenarios.expected_result: The application opens the project creation workflow.

scenarios.title: Switch Application Theme to Dark Mode
scenarios.business_objective: Allow user to switch the visual theme of the application to dark mode for improved readability or preference.
preconditions: User is navigating the application page in standard display mode.
steps: User clicks the 'Switch to dark mode' button.
scenarios.expected_result: The application interface theme updates to dark mode.

scenarios.title: Open Demo Project
scenarios.business_objective: Enable the user to open and explore the built-in demo project.
preconditions: User is on the main application interface.
steps: User clicks the 'Open the demo project' button.
scenarios.expected_result: The system loads and displays the demo project context.

scenarios.title: Access BRD Compliance Criterion Level View
scenarios.business_objective: Allow user to navigate directly to the BRD compliance criterion level information.
preconditions: User is navigating the application page.
steps: User clicks the 'BRD compliance criterion level' button.
scenarios.expected_result: The system navigates to and displays the BRD compliance criterion level view.

scenarios.title: Create New Project
scenarios.business_objective: Allow user to trigger the creation of a new project within the system.
preconditions: User is on the main navigation or workspace page.
scenarios.expected_result: The system opens the project creation screen or initiates a new project workflow.

scenarios.title: Delete Item or Resource
scenarios.business_objective: Enable users to remove selected items or projects from the system
preconditions: User is logged into the application
An item or project eligible for deletion is selected or visible
steps: User locates the item to be deleted
User clicks the delete button (selector: LOC-0005)
User confirms the deletion request if prompted
scenarios.expected_result: The target item or project is removed from the system

scenarios.title: Access Shopflow Demo
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to open and explore the Shopflow demo project
preconditions: User is on the main application interface
steps: User navigates to the demo section
User clicks the Shopflow demo option (selector: LOC-0006)
scenarios.expected_result: The Shopflow demo project interface is loaded and displayed to the user

scenarios.title: Execute Open Action
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to open selected resources or views
preconditions: User is navigating the application page
steps: User selects the item or document to be viewed
User clicks the open action button (selector: LOC-0007)
scenarios.expected_result: The target item or document is opened and rendered in the view
